tagline: INDONESIA'S GATEWAY TO FURNITURE AND CRAFT.

story.title: A national bridge between Indonesian makers, global buyers and the furniture value chain.
story.body: HIMKI represents Indonesia’s furniture and craft industry and positions itself as a gateway connecting buyers, investors, designers and partners with manufacturers and artisans. The organization highlights 18 production regions, 2,500+ verified suppliers and a US$6 billion export vision for 2031.

highlights.title: Buyer gateway

highlights.body: Eighteen production regions are presented as strategic furniture and craft manufacturing hubs.

highlights.title: Design + market access

highlights.title: Export acceleration
highlights.body: HIMKI and government partners are actively framing growth around stronger global market access.
